what: Aged-out pipeline reports HEALTHY, not unknown: grey banner on 25h-old data

GET /snapshots/latest as OH -> 200 {status:SUCCESS, dataAsOf:2026-09-01T12:00:08Z, lastSuccessAt:2026-09-01T12:01:32Z} = ~25h old. isStuck() (SnapshotBanner.tsx:31) returns false unless status is RUNNING, so a SUCCESS of any age is never stuck; failed=false; wedged=false. Banner therefore renders the calm grey role=status 'Snapshot: data as of ...' line. This is the HEALTHY-STATE reading, NOT unknown/absent - the finding as stated. Zero-row shape confirmed at source: quietRuns SQL (health.service.ts:359-369) COUNTs SUCCESS master_sync_runs only, so zero rows gives quietRuns 0, quietRunsAlert = 0>3 = false, contributing healthy=true; deriveIngestionAlert (ingestion-alert.ts:139-176) with runs=[] gives latestStatus null, streak 0, alert false, downstreamGated false. Live lifecycle.quietRuns=0/quietRunsAlert=false with 2 real runs. masterSync.ageMinutes=1293 IS computed by the backend and thrown away by the admin client - the one number that would show staleness. Reaper is still call-site-only (snapshot-run.service.ts:63), no standalone cron.
policyClause: a detector that counts runs that happened cannot see silence; no absolute-age rule anywhere
